name: Ninja’s Edge (Ex)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Unchained Ninja Master Tricks
body:
Prerequisite: Master tricks

Benefit: A ninja with this trick gains the rogue’s edge class ability and immediately selects a single skill with this class feature. In addition, she can select the cutting edge advanced talent to select additional skills with her rogue’s edge ability.
